mapping.draft_py:
# Fake Your Own Death: "Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature
# dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure
# token.""
# M21 Sure Strike's shape ("Target creature gets +3/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn":
# MODIFY_PT and GRANT_ABILITY, each until end of turn, over one TARGET selector, one slot), with
# the granted ability a TriggeredAbility as in M21 Infernal Scarring's "has 'When this creature
# dies, ...'". Its effect, in printed order:
#   - "return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control": MOVE_ZONE of the dying
#     creature (the event referent, templates_b2b._event_reference) under `cards`, to
#     Zone(BATTLEFIELD, OWNER) (selectors.move_destination: OWNER = under its owner's control),
#     tapped_on_enter (M20 Brought Back's and FDN Gravewaker's "...to the battlefield tapped",
#     M21 Silversmote Ghoul's `cards` move). Not under `target`: that lane of verbs._v_move_zone
#     never stamps tapped_on_enter (the creature came back untapped, stronger than printed).
#   - "you create a Treasure token": CREATE_TOKEN of the corpus' Treasure spec (M21 Gadrak; FDN
#     Gleaming Barrier's "When this creature dies, create a Treasure token."). "You" is the granted
#     trigger's controller: the creature's controller as it died (CR 603.3a).
# The compiled card keyword TREASURE (MTGJSON) is kept.
treasure = TokenSpec(
    name='Treasure',
    type_line='Artifact',
    types=('Artifact',),
    subtypes=(),
    power=None,
    toughness=None,
    keywords=(Keyword.TREASURE,),
    abilities=(
        ActivatedAbility(
            cost=Cost(parts=(
                CostSacrifice(target=Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                )),
                CostTap(),
            )),
            effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'color': 'ANY', 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
dies_return = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CreatureDiesEvent(filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(steps=(
        A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                referent='event',
            ),
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
            'tapped_on_enter': True,
        }),
        A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {'count': QConst(value=1), 'tokens': treasure}),
    )),
)
target = Selector(
    count=QConst(value=1),
    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
)
abilities = [
    SpellAbility(
        kind=SpellKind.INSTANT,
        effect=Seq(steps=(
            A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=2)),
                'target': target,
                'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=0)),
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': dies_return,
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': target,
            }),
        )),
    ),
]

clauses.clause: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield tapped under its owner's control and you create a Treasure token."
clauses.ir: abilities[0].effect.steps[0] (+2/+0 until end of turn), abilities[0].effect.steps[1] (the granted trigger until end of turn: .args.ability.effect.steps[0] returns it tapped under its owner's control, .steps[1] creates the Treasure); keywords[0] (TREASURE, MTGJSON)

mapping.notes: Sure Strike's 'gets +2/+0 and gains ...' over one TARGET slot, the granted ability a dies trigger as in M21 Infernal Scarring. Its return is a MOVE_ZONE of the event referent under the `cards` role to Zone(BATTLEFIELD, OWNER), tapped_on_enter: under the `target` role verbs._v_move_zone moves by controller_of and never stamps tapped_on_enter, so the creature came back untapped (an engine fault, reported). 'You' (the Treasure's maker) is the trigger's controller, the creature's controller as it died. Treasure spec as M21 Gadrak / FDN Gleaming Barrier; MTGJSON keyword TREASURE kept. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/fake_your_own_death_*.json (returns tapped with its controller's Treasure, paid for Giant Growth; an opponent's creature returns to its owner, who gets the Treasure; nothing on the next turn).
